intro: Christu Jyoti is a co-educational school, and admission is open to all good and earnest students, irrespective of caste or creed. Places are offered after a test and an interview, in line with age-limit norms.

steps.title: Online registration
steps.text: Register your child on the school’s online admission portal, or visit the school office for help.

steps.title: Entrance test
steps.text: Your child sits a short, age-appropriate test. [[TO CONFIRM: test format and syllabus by class]]

steps.title: Interview
steps.text: We meet the child and parents to get to know your family and answer your questions.

steps.title: Admission
steps.text: Successful applicants complete formalities, submit documents and pay fees to confirm the place.

eligibility: Open to all good and earnest students, irrespective of caste or creed.
Admission is granted only after the entrance test and interview.
Every admission is subject to the school’s age-limit norms.
Class XI: students appearing for the ICSE examination must apply afresh. Selection considers class and laboratory capacity, ICSE performance, and conduct in Classes VIII–X.

faq.a: Every good and earnest student, irrespective of caste or creed. Christu Jyoti is co-educational and English-medium.
Use the Online Registration link on this page. If you need help, call the school office on +91 75000 01547 between 9:00 AM and 1:00 PM, or visit us at Jyotinagar.

faq.q: Which classes can I apply for?
faq.a: In the last admission cycle, registration was open for Nursery to Class IX. Class XI admission is for students who have appeared for the ICSE examination. [[TO CONFIRM: classes open for the next session]]
Yes. Admission is granted only after a test and an interview, and is subject to age-limit norms.

Fees are payable quarterly. The office will share the current fee structure at registration. About ten percent of eligible students receive a fee concession every year. [[TO CONFIRM: publish the fee structure?]]
Yes. Boarding offers an environment that is the next best thing to being at home. Please contact the office for availability. [[TO CONFIRM: boarding for boys, girls, or both; from which class]]
Yes, the school runs its own transport for safe conveyance. [[TO CONFIRM: routes and areas covered]]

faq.q: When can I meet the Principal?
faq.a: On working days from 9:00 AM to 12:00 noon in summer and 10:00 AM to 1:00 PM in winter, or by appointment.
